method.policy: Visible first-wave heuristic or uniform legal swap; both use the first unlocked S. Neither simulates future refills.
method.randomPolicy: Independent LCG (1664525*x+1013904223) modulo 2^32, initialized with seed XOR 0x72ef4913; one draw per swap choice.
method.rewards: Highest offered rarity, replace only an empty slot or lower rarity. No purchases, build optimization or skill changes.
method.avoidHealing: Reject cottonCuffs and goldenLining rewards; keep insurance. This changes gear and later offers, not just healing amounts.
method.hpSpent: Actual HP removed including enemy hits, bombs and item payments, reconstructed as beforeHp + combatHealing + 8*levelDelta - afterHp.
method.barrierGranted: Actual barrier added, not a claim about damage absorbed.
method.defensiveSwaps: Chosen exchanges with positive estimated protection from visible first-wave defense groups.
method.rawFlurry: Declared damage before the action. Same-action weaken procs can lower the eventual hit; HP-loss maxima use actual enemy frames.
method.denominators: Run means include deaths. Room means condition on entering that room. Biome means condition on entering that biome and include interrupted routes.
method.replay: First and last seed of each cohort replayed through saveGame/loadGame.
method.limitation: Automated policy comparison, not human win rates, fun or a balance target.
